race.comment: SHIRLEY NOT (3) finished third last start over 1800m at Globe Derby Park, beaten 8 metres, after a modest fourth there the run prior. Will enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. Facing a tougher assignment but she is good enough to turn things around. WHITEHAVEN BEACH (1) won at this track two runs ago before having his colours lowered at his latest appearance over 1790m here, beaten 10 metres. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. Certainly cannot be faulted after that last effort and is good enough to take out a race like this. RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE (10) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish second at this course over 2190m. Genuine threat. CAULONIA TERROR (7) cannot be left out after solid recent performances, the latest a sound third at this venue over 2190m.
